facts.fact: ITWeb reports Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group signed a binding tripartite agreement to operationalise the Horizon Fiber Initiative, a terrestrial fibre corridor linking Djibouti's submarine cable gateways through Ethiopia to Sudan; signing date is taken from the article's date, 2026-02-06.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
